votes.refutation: Tried to show that the settings endpoint is hit at a rate that could flood logs during a stamphog DB outage. It is not: settings load once per Code review scene mount (plus explicit user actions), the recurring 10s poll only reloads the reviews list, and the scene is feature-flag gated to an alpha audience. Per-request `logger.exception` in a deliberately fail-soft path is the same pattern the circuit breaker itself uses (db_circuit_breaker.py:243, 272), and the breaker already publishes a rate-limited open/closed warning and metric, so the requested counter and sampled logging duplicate existing telemetry. No production configuration makes the described log storm reachable; the finding is a speculative operational concern at a low-traffic endpoint.
